_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 32: 22-25 November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he moved on from the 13 April timeframe to July, sees July highlighted with much to pray about, and repeats that there is a major storm concerning July.
mentions.quote: July is highlighted and there is much to pray about concerning July
mentions.falsify_match: A major storm in July 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable July storm. Storm is not defined as weather or metaphor, which loosens it considerably.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not understand it and it does not matter, it is to be prayed out, that it concerns Easter in April and the 13th was highlighted to him, and that his ears are getting hot again so he will go back into it.
mentions.quote: It's concerning Easter in the April and the 13th was highlighted
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable on 13 April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes unremarkably. He states outright he does not know what it means.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told not to look so much at what can be seen because it is not what is expected, that just because it is the 250th anniversary it will be a day when you are not expecting, and recalls the black swan.
mentions.quote: it'll be a day when you're not expecting
mentions.falsify_match: A major surprise event on a date nobody flagged.
mentions.falsify_miss: Structurally unfalsifiable: it forecasts a date that cannot be named, so no date can disconfirm it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is saying not to go by what is obvious, that people assume it will be 4 July 2026 because of 1776 and that is not the obvious one, and reaches for Pearl Harbor as the comparison.
mentions.quote: Don't go by what is obvious. The Lord is saying today
mentions.falsify_match: An attack that lands away from 4 July 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: An attack on 4 July 2026 itself would contradict this, which is the one thing here that can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is not one and done but something to keep cultivating in the spiritual gym, that they should pray over the nation concerning 2026, and that they will have a red wave.
mentions.quote: you pray over our nation concerning 2026 and we will have a red wave
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans gain in the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: Democrats gain, though the prayer framing lets a loss be blamed on insufficient prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for help reaching the million mark and says he believes that by 2026 they will have the million men and women prayer army, calling it a push and a goal they have been believing for.
mentions.quote: I believe by 2026 we will have the million men and women prayer army
mentions.falsify_match: A million subscribers or prayer-army members by end of 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Short of a million. He hedges it as a goal rather than a word, which is the honest framing.

mentions.claim_text: He declares restoration of the fountain of wealth to a family and repayment of what the cankerworm ate over the last four and a half to five years, naming persecution they received in New York and their businesses and dealings.
mentions.quote: restore what the cankerworm ate over the last four and a half, five years
mentions.time_phrase: the last four and a half to five years
mentions.falsify_match: The family's finances and legal position restored.
mentions.falsify_miss: No restoration, though no deadline is given.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to call their seeds forth, saying that though they may not have had a harvest or been paid, God will bring restitution.
mentions.quote: Call those seeds forth
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on calling the seeds forth
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: restitution with no amount, recipient or deadline.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they have to pray for JD Vance to win in 2028 and make sure there is no new Watergate, that the enemy would try to derail the next term, and that he sees Vance at the helm as a major face.
mentions.quote: I see JD Vance at the helm as a major face
mentions.falsify_match: Vance wins the 2028 presidential election.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not win, or is not the nominee.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must pray for him to finish the next term, that God is looking into the next three and a half years, and reminds listeners they do not pray for a thing to happen but against it.
mentions.quote: God's looking into the next three and a half years
mentions.time_phrase: the next three and a half years
mentions.falsify_match: The term is completed.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Three and a half years is also the tribulation half-week, which he does not gloss here.

mentions.claim_text: He says some are not doing rituals themselves but are attached to people who are, and that one of them is George and the one in Asia is another, saying he has seen them doing it and knows it for a fact.
mentions.quote: that one is George and the one in Asia is
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an accusation of secret ritual against a partly named man, with sight offered as the evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not see a vision as a prophecy but as a means to change things through prayer, that he says this is what he sees and this is what God is showing, and that he has seen prayer change things.
mentions.quote: I don't see a vision as a prophecy
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the clearest statement of the frame that makes every miss survivable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are waiting to strike Israel again in another surprise attack that will happen at night, that it will be worse than any October 7th imaginable, and that they want retaliation for Iran.
mentions.quote: this time it will be worse than any October 7th you can imagine
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel exceeding 7 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack, but with no deadline it cannot come due.

mentions.claim_text: He rebukes ministers ruled by their mother or their wife, telling them to stand up and have a backbone like a crowbar or they will not make it in what they are called to do and say.
mentions.quote: HAVE A BACKBONE LIKE A CROWBAR
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a rebuke with no named subject.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says his true prophetic words do not go with the crowd, and reports being told to get ready because 2026 will be the year of 1 Corinthians 5:5, for many of his ministers have lost their way and are not preaching the truth.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be the year of 1 Corinthians 5:5
mentions.falsify_match: A run of ministers falling publicly in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such run.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he will save the celebrities and use them for his glory, naming Mel Gibson and telling listeners to watch what God will do with Chris, and answers the objection that nobody cares by saying it is about carrying the message.
mentions.quote: I WILL SAVE THEM, BRANDON, AND I will use them for my glory
mentions.falsify_match: Public conversions among named celebrities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though one of the two named men is already publicly devout, which lowers the bar.

mentions.claim_text: He says those going horizontal are in trouble in the days ahead, and reports another word that great political theatre will happen in 2026, adding that he does not know what that means.
mentions.quote: great political theater will happen in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Any dramatic political spectacle in a midterm year.
mentions.falsify_miss: Effectively impossible to miss. He admits he does not know what it means.

mentions.claim_text: He says they keep a tally of how many people gave their heart to Jesus through the ministry in 2025.
mentions.quote: keep a tally of how many people gave their heart to Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: A published figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: no number is given here.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord usually maps out the whole coming year for him towards the end of December, giving an outline of what will happen and what he is to pray over, and that this year's is his most shaking word yet.
mentions.quote: Usually the Lord will map out the whole year of 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A December 2025 video laying out 2026 point by point, which is checkable in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such video.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord tells him to sit down and take notes on what to pray into for the year, and that every single time it is always right and always the major things they end up seeing.
mentions.quote: every single time it's always right
mentions.falsify_match: A self-assessment of a perfect record, and the one claim in the corpus this whole database is built to check.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any prior year's outline that did not land.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have a great plan coming out for the rest of 2025 and into 2026 to raise up prayer warriors for this generation, which he says will be birthed out of prayer and fuelled by prayer.
mentions.quote: raise up prayer warriors for this generation
mentions.falsify_match: A launched programme.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
